Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a side-impact collision at an intersection in Baytown, Texas. Driver 1 was
proceeding through the intersection when the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle.
Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as described by Driver 1, and two independent witnesses gave consistent
accounts of the impact and the position of both vehicles. Scene photographs were taken and show damage to the
driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle that corresponds with the direction and force of the impact. Passenger was seated in
the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the crash, a fact confirmed by Driver 1, Driver 2, and the
witnesses. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain at the scene and was evaluated by responding personnel, with
symptoms consistent with the forces involved. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was observed or reported. Driver
1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved. No citations were issued at the scene
pending further review of the collision.
